confirmed: Enter at the opening price immediately after the first eligible confirmed UTC 12-hour key of the New York week.
early: Enter at the next hourly open after the first hourly reclaim of the developing key, one attempt per New York week. At that key's 12-hour close exit at the new open if the same key and side did not confirm. No re-entry or fallback. Confirmation is used only once its bar closes.
protection: The original ETH fixed stop is 1.5% beyond the pierced NY Monday 1.618 rail. The 12-hour EMA20/EMA50 intrabar reversal uses a price threshold from the prior completed 12-hour bar. Both protections start at entry. An open position at data end is settled at the final hourly close.
execution: NautilusTrader 1.231.0, independent hedged positions. Both arms use market and stop-market orders. No modeled spread, slippage or funding. Fixed initial risk, no compounding or margin constraints.
large_move: For the original formal keys whose chart peak_lower_r reached a threshold, count same-key and direction trades which demonstrably reached that many units of their own entry-to-original-stop distance while open. Lower bound excludes unsequenced favorable extremes in the stop hour. Upper bound includes them. Thresholds are price excursions, not take profits.
drawdown: Peak-to-trough drop of aggregate hourly closing mark-to-market P&L including open positions and actual paid fees, in units of the common 100 USDT initial risk. The curve starts at zero.
uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap over NY calendar weeks, four consecutive weeks per block including inactive weeks; 10000 repetitions, seed 20261115. Descriptive sampling intervals for early minus confirmed.
